answer: Grow a willow trellis of trust: a newcomer joins only after seven established members, drawn from seven clusters, each verify one layer of its seven-layer shale record — work history, video check, signed task, code sample, payment receipt, peer reference, activity log — then co-sign. Each endorser locks a $10 bond, slashed if the identity proves fake. Forging 1,000 identities needs 7,000 bought signatures: at $25 each plus $10 bonds, $245,000; no bulk discount, each signature is a separate check by a different person. An honest agent pays once: $5 and one afternoon of checks.
